references.text: The same description of the promised land as 'a land flowing with milk and honey' - God's promise to Moses at the burning bush
The land flowing with milk and honey is mentioned in connection with the Feast of Unleavened Bread
Caleb and Joshua describe the land flowing with milk and honey after spying it out
Moses exhorts Israel to keep the commandments in the land flowing with milk and honey
The promise that they will live long in the land flowing with milk and honey
The fulfillment of the promise - Israel wandered in the wilderness until they came to the land flowing with milk and honey
Jeremiah refers to the land flowing with milk and honey as God promised the fathers
Ezekiel describes the promised land as the most glorious of all lands, flowing with milk and honey
